identity.name: Admirals Cove
identity.hoa_name: Master Property Owners Association (MPOA) at Admirals Cove
identity.notes: Luxury gated waterfront community in Jupiter, FL with approximately 893-900 residences (mixed single family, villas, and condos) on nearly 1,000 acres. Managed by the Master Property Owners Association (MPOA), which oversees multiple sub-associations (e.g., Waterside, Spyglass). Utilities: Florida Power & Light (electric), Town of Jupiter Utilities (water), Loxahatchee River District (sewer), Solid Waste Authority of Palm Beach County (trash). Rules: pets allowed on leash, short-term rentals prohibited, commercial vehicles prohibited.

fees.note: Observed median $980/mo; reported resident range $867-$2,300/mo (other sources cite ~$1,000-$2,300/mo). Fees vary by property type, waterfront vs. golf course location, and sub-association (MPOA plus condo associations); often billed quarterly. Verify with association directly. Transfer fees and special assessments not detailed in public sources (2 assessment signals noted).
